title: Chapter 1221
text:
The moment Rivervale defeated the Thunder Python, the Chinese players could not wait to flood the forums, venting their joy and excitement.

"Congratulations, Rivervale! Congratulations, China! "

"Three-in-a-row, amazing!"

"Hahahaha, continue to surround our teams. Even if they target us, we will still be able to break through!"

"That's great. Those little tricks against us won't work anymore. You have to be strong enough to forge iron!"

"Congratulations, North America, first place (laughing emoji)"

Ever since the start of the group stage, the Chinese players had been suppressing their anger. They could only watch as the Chinese teams suffered unfair treatment and were constantly targeted. Now, they could finally hold their heads up high and vent out all the frustration in their hearts.

Since the second season of the Pro League, Long Sky, Dynasty, and Rivervale had each brought a championship trophy to China. As the saying went, 'Nothing is done more than three times'. Winning three consecutive championships had a special meaning in the eyes of the players. It meant that they were dominating and extremely honorable.

The official members of the Rivervale Club quickly posted an announcement after their team won the championship. In just three minutes, the number of replies exceeded a million, and all of them congratulated them. With the popularity of winning the championship, it instantly rose to the top of the trending list.

The Chinese players were not the only ones who came to congratulate them. Making history by winning three consecutive championships also attracted a large number of fans overseas. Among the players of various countries, there were also many spectators who had been supporting the Chinese teams. Achievements were not separated by nationality. Even the supporters of the other teams felt like they were witnessing history at this moment.

Dynasty, Long Sky, and the other Chinese teams that had been eliminated early also posted congratulatory posts in the name of their clubs at the same time, celebrating China's historic achievement of winning three consecutive championships. They mentioned that this was the result of everyone's hard work. The efforts of the Chinese teams in the previous two seasons had laid the foundation for winning three consecutive championships, and many players approved of it.

While the Chinese were celebrating, many of the foreign teams were feeling terrible. Their sniping had failed, and the teams that had participated in it were mocked and ridiculed. They were disappointed and helpless.

We did everything we could, but we still couldn't stop China from winning the championship. What else can we do? We can only accept reality.

"Three-in-a-row … Impressive indeed."

In the office, Han Xiao looked at the celebration on the forums and could not help but smile.

In his previous life, no country had ever achieved three consecutive championships. Even the most dominant team, North America, had won three consecutive championships, but they were all separated. Now, under his influence, the Chinese teams that could not even win the championship in his previous life had achieved such a good result and become the dominant team. He also felt proud.

As the main faction of the Chinese players, the benefits were obvious. He could foresee that the faction's attraction would increase again, which was extremely beneficial to his plan. In the next version, if the other factions came to poach him, the success rate would definitely further decrease.

Han Xiao was secretly overjoyed, and he immediately recalled his thoughts during the Country War.

"Hmm, it's time to give them a reward …"

The Yan Huang Alliance had become the winner of the national war. Back then, Han Xiao had planned to buy Planet Milton and give it to the Yan Huang Alliance as a reward. Now was the best time.

Although Planet Alliance, the Alliance, and Planet Alliance, Alliance's, Star, Star, and Alliance, to find find find a way... but that did not. With the status of the army, no matter which force obtained Planet Milton in the end, they would not stop such a small transaction. This way, it was equivalent to reserving Planet Milton. As long as the war ended, they could pay and receive the ball.

…

In the ten days after the Rivervale team won the championship, the forums were still very popular.

During this period of time, Galaxy Times sped up their production and finally produced a new episode. They invited the three-time champion teams of Rivervale, Dynasty, and Long Sky as guests. It was an unprecedented event.

Han Xiao was also watching, and the comments were all over the screen. On the screen, a male and female host sat on one side, and the players of the three teams led by Mad Blade, King Admiral, and Hao Tian sat down. The interview had already started for a while.

"… Since the first Pro League, we have witnessed the rise of Rivervale step by step. The team has continued to mature, and after four versions, they finally obtained the highest honor and laid the foundation for being a powerhouse. Captain Mad Blade, what do you think about this?" the female host asked.

With a proud smile, Mad Blade said, "First of all, I would like to thank the club for nurturing me. After the first Pro League, Rivervale decided to rebuild the team and gave me a lot of power. It can be said that without their support, there would not be the current team. "Next, I would like to thank my teammates. Everyone worked hard together to achieve the results we have today. Without our cooperation, we would not have the glory we have today.

"Then, I would like to thank Dynasty, Long Sky, and the other Chinese teams. Without their efforts in the first two Pro Leagues, we would not have been able to obtain the honor of three consecutive championships. This is the result of all the Chinese teams' hard work. Everyone is fighting for the glory of the country.

"Finally, I would like to thank the Black Star Corps. Although it is a little strange to say this, to be honest, I think that the Black Star Corps played an irreplaceable role in China's championship. They might even be one of the main factors."

The male host nodded. "There is indeed such a saying on the internet. Many people think that China's achievement of three consecutive championships cannot be separated from the unique faction benefits. In other words, there is a huge element of luck involved. Do you think so too?"

Mad Blade agreed.

"You can say that. The old players who have been through four versions all understand that the Black Star Corps was very weak at the beginning. At the very beginning, it was us who built it with our blood, sweat, and tears, and it also brought us long-term benefits.

"To be able to join such a faction with such a bright future at the very beginning is our luck. There is no need to deny this. Of course, the contribution of the team is equally important. As the saying goes, if a worker wants to do a good job, he must first sharpen his tools. The faction allowed us to develop very well, and we also used this resource to give a satisfactory answer."

Hao Tian chimed in. "Mad Blade is right. The Black Star Corps has a part of the glory of three consecutive championships."

In Version 1.0, he was one of the 'Four Great Generals' under Han Xiao. At this time, he also agreed with Mad Blade's words.

Although it was a little strange to mention an NPC faction in the championship interview, most Chinese players would not have such a feeling. After four versions, the Black Star Corps had already given them a strong sense of belonging, and they treated it as one of their own.

Seeing that the topic had reached this point, the female host flipped through the inscription card and asked, "Speaking of the Black Star Corps, just a few days ago, Black Star publicly announced that he would buy Planet Milton and give it to his subordinate faction, the Golden Alliance, as a base. This caused quite a stir, and the Chinese players called it a double blessing. What do you think about this?"

Hearing this, everyone turned to look at Maple Moon. She was recognized as a storyline player among the professional players, so everyone felt that her answer was more reliable.

Maple Moon thought for a while and said, "I think that although the Corps Commander's action was a little sudden, it is actually not strange if you think about it carefully. Everyone must remember that when we were in the World War, there were many spaceships of NPC factions on Planet Milton. With our sense of existence in the universe, it is impossible for Black Star not to pay attention to our World War.

Although the NPCs do not know what we are doing, they can make basic judgments. I will try to put myself in the Corps Commander's shoes … Although he does not understand why we are fighting, in his eyes, this is probably an internal conflict among the Immortals. He did not want to get involved, but the Golden Alliance is a registered subordinate organization under him, and among the opponents are the Immortals of the Supercluster Alliance faction, so he created an environment of faction conflict.

Therefore, when he saw that the Corps' subordinate organization defeated all the enemies, he probably felt satisfied and gratified. Then, when he saw that we stayed on the battlefield of Planet Milton and built a main city, this scene may have made him think that we are reluctant to part with this planet, so he generously bought an entire planet and gave it to the Golden Alliance. The fundamental purpose of this move is actually to reward the subordinate organizations under him. "

After Maple Moon's analysis, many of the audience suddenly understood. They felt that the cause and effect were clear, and a large number of comments appeared on the screen.

"As expected of a professional player who is good at unearthing hidden plots. Her thinking is quite clear. I understand now."

"What's the point of all this nonsense? Just shout that the Corps Commander is awesome!"

"We are in a World War, and the faction actually gives us benefits. Only the Black Star Corps can receive such treatment. This is too comfortable."

The World War was a spontaneous activity of the players. There was originally no reward, but because of Black Star's generosity, there was now an additional reward.

Moreover, if the guild alliances of the other factions won the World War, they would not receive such benefits. Only the Black Star Corps players won the World War and received such treatment. Wasn't this just too lucky?

The eyes of the guilds of the other factions turned red with envy and jealousy.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smiled with satisfaction. He liked players with excellent imagination like this. They gave his army a sense of presence.

The two hosts asked many questions one after another, giving the players of the three teams room to express themselves. The interview ended in a happy atmosphere. Then, they entered the last segment of the program, which was to review the history of this version and predict the situation of the next version.

The male host sat up straight and slowly said, "In the World War, we have seen a lot of changes.

For example, the establishment of the Beyond Grade A Association, Black Star's Godlike Battle, the outbreak of the Intelligent Plague, Black Star receiving the Galaxy Medal and being hired as a consultant by the three Universal Civilizations, the outbreak of the conflict between the three Universal Civilizations and the Supercluster Alliance, and so on … We have also experienced a lot, such as the establishment of a large number of subordinate organizations, the Blackstar Cup, participation in the Flickering World War, national wars, and so on. We have achieved so much … "

Many of the audience members were pulled back into the memories and reviewed the rich experiences of the past few years.

Then, the female host said, "We have experienced a lot in Version 4.0. The opening of the World Server gave this version a special meaning. However, the situation of the universe is still in turmoil, so it's difficult for us to see what will happen in Version 5.0. We can only make some guesses based on the information we have.

"This is the early stage of the Flickering World War. Who knows how many years will pass between Version 4.0 and Version 5.0. The way we see it, the next version will very likely jump to the end of the war and let us participate in the final battle. The process in the middle will be omitted. I feel like it will be more than ten years later …"

Hearing the guesses of the Galaxy Times, Han Xiao shook his head. "They guessed wrong this time."

From the perspective of the players, the Flickering World War was like a red tide. They thought that this would be a cross-version main storyline. Of course, they would not have thought that the main storyline of Version 5.0 would be the Calamity of the Supers. In his previous life, the players were also involved in this conflict.

However, this was not surprising. The level of the players was not high enough, so they did not have many clues. The Calamity of the Supers was also very sudden, so basically no one could guess what it was.

Now that the butterfly effect was constantly expanding, the direction of Version 5.0 would most likely be even more confusing. Even he could not be sure, let alone the players.

While thinking, Han Xiao's finger gently slid across the edge of the desk, and a blue virtual screen immediately popped out.

He looked at the date on the upper right corner and exhaled.

"There are only twenty-seven days left until the version update in my previous life. Version 4.0 is finally coming to an end …"
